_comment: Frozen cross-repository integration contract for Soberanía Protocol. Shipped inside the @aoc/protocol tarball so a consumer can verify, offline and without network access, that what it installed is the surface it agreed to depend on. This file describes an integration surface; it authorizes no publication, deployment, registry access, or release. Normative prose: docs/integration/CROSS_REPO_INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.md in Soberania-Protocol/Soberania_Protocol.

lastMetadataUpdate.what: The candidate identity this contract binds moved to 0.2.0-rc.3. The export set, export map digest, install forms and consumer obligations are all unchanged — only package identity moved, which is why changeControl classifies this as a patch and not a minor. The package behind that identity changes caller-visible verification semantics: an issuer supplied to manifest or claim verification is now an expected issuer that must equal the issuer the signed content names, instead of replacing it. That is a package behaviour change, classified minor in its changeset and recorded in its changelog, not a change to this contract.

burnedCandidate.reason: security defect SOBE-SEC-01 (N1): a caller-supplied issuer could replace the issuer named in a signed manifest or claim as the identity issuer binding was verified for; 0.2.0-rc.0 and 0.2.0-rc.1 carry the same defect
burnedCandidate.evidenceRetained: docs/release/evidence/aoc-protocol-0.2.0-rc.2-* and rc-artifact-0.2.0-rc.2.md are immutable and unmodified; see docs/release/RELEASE_CANDIDATE_READINESS.md sections 10 and 11

previousMetadataUpdates.what: The candidate identity this contract binds moved to 0.2.0-rc.2. The export set, export map digest, install forms and consumer obligations are all unchanged — only package identity moved, which is why changeControl classifies this as a patch and not a minor. The package behind that identity verifies signatures and issuer bindings more strictly than 0.2.0-rc.1; that is a package behaviour change recorded in its changelog, not a change to this contract.

burnedCandidate.reason: security defect SOBE-SEC-01: manifest and claim verification could report an issuer binding as verified without cryptographically tying the signing key to the registered issuer key; 0.2.0-rc.0 carries the same defect
burnedCandidate.evidenceRetained: docs/release/evidence/aoc-protocol-0.2.0-rc.1-* are immutable and unmodified; see docs/release/RELEASE_CANDIDATE_READINESS.md section 10

previousMetadataUpdates.what: The candidate identity this contract binds moved to 0.2.0-rc.1. The export set, export map digest, install forms and consumer obligations are all unchanged — only package identity moved, which is why changeControl classifies this as a patch and not a minor.

burnedCandidate.reason: canonicalizeJSON truncated the exponent of numbers rendered in exponential notation with a fractional mantissa, so distinct values could produce identical canonical bytes and therefore identical digests
burnedCandidate.evidenceRetained: docs/release/evidence/aoc-protocol-0.2.0-rc.0-* are immutable and unmodified; see docs/release/RELEASE_CANDIDATE_READINESS.md sections 8 and 9

protocol.packageRepositoryUrlNote: packages/protocol/package.json still declares the pre-rebrand slug, as does the rest of this repository (frontend, docs, and tests assert it). The git remote this contract was frozen from is Soberania-Protocol/Soberania_Protocol. Both identifiers are recorded rather than reconciled: whether they are one renamed repository is a GitHub-side fact this repository does not evidence, and consumers follow the URL in the package metadata.
protocol.esmConsumption: supported via Node's CommonJS named-export analysis; this is NOT a dual package — there are no separate import/require export conditions

distribution.candidateIdentityDerivedBy: Changesets pre mode (tag rc) — .changeset/pre.json. The 0.2.0 minor derives from pre-existing accumulated changesets; the rc.2 iteration derived from the SOBE-SEC-01 security changeset, and the rc.3 iteration from the SOBE-SEC-01 N1 expected-issuer changeset (minor; same version under either classification). Computed by `changeset version`, never hand-edited.

protocol.exportMapDigestNote: sha256 of the canonically ordered `exports` object, as computed by scripts/fingerprint-public-surface.mjs. It pins the export surface itself: implementation may evolve freely (the build-output digest is deliberately NOT frozen), but the set of export keys and the files they point at cannot move without deliberately updating this value, and that update requires a Changeset. This digest is unchanged from the pre-candidate commit 2e89f42.

contractFile.packagedAs: integration-contract.json at the root of the tarball
contractFile.rationale: P0-PKG-01 requires the public export surface to be unchanged by this increment, so the contract ships as an unexported metadata file — the same class as LICENSE and NOTICE — and is read by path (node_modules/@aoc/protocol/integration-contract.json), not by module specifier. Promoting it to a declared export would be an additive public-API change requiring its own approved public-API decision and a minor Changeset.
contractFile.readBy: consumer CI verification, not application code

forbiddenImportForms: any path into the installed package that is not a declared export key
guarantees: no import of Enterprise, PMFreak, persistence, transport, or observability implementations
two consecutive packs of one commit are byte-identical
the tarball contains dist, LICENSE, NOTICE, README.md and this contract file — no src, tests, fixtures, or secrets

producesForPmfreak.note: This repository builds an Assurance workspace named @aoc/enterprise under enterprise/. It does not build, own, or publish an artifact named @aoc-enterprise/runtime, and it holds no evidence that Soberanía Enterprise publishes one. Which repository owns that identifier, and under which name it is distributed, is an Enterprise-side fact that must be recorded before the three-repository packaging proof can close.

pmfreak.currentDeclarationClassification: repository-local source copy — not a packaged dependency; it proves nothing about independent packaging

requiredDeclaration.@aoc/protocol: file:./vendor/aoc-protocol-<version>.tgz (until a registry is authorized, then the exact version)
requiredDeclaration.@aoc-enterprise/runtime: the packaged form Soberanía Enterprise distributes, once the unresolved item above is closed

obligations: install the packed artifact, never a path into a source tree
record repository, commit, version and SHA-256 of the installed artifact in a consumer lock file
verify the installed package's integration-contract.json contractVersion against the version it was built for
import only through declared export keys
run a blocking CI job that reinstalls the pinned artifact and re-runs the consumer battery

allowed: packed tarball pinned by SHA-256 (current state)
exact semver version from an authorized registry (after a founder publication decision)
forbidden: file: specifiers pointing at a source tree rather than a packed tarball
copied or vendored source, type shims, ambient declarations, or hand-maintained duplicates of protocol shapes

changeControl.frozenMeaning: The export set, package identity, install forms and consumer obligations recorded here may not change silently. Any change requires editing this file, bumping contractVersion, and a Changeset — enforced by scripts/check-integration-contract.mjs.
